about: Server singleton alive from the first idle level on (seen.py context: idle / act1-idle / level-change, nothing done). Written by esv::trade::TraderMapTrackingSystem (macOS: ProcessAddedTraders writes it), read by TraderMapMarkersSystem. Live: four allocated, empty hash sets.

evidence.says: EoCServer.dll esv::trade::TraderMapTrackingSystem::ApplyComponentChanges copies FrameData+0/+0x30/+0x60/+0x90 (4 HashSets) into the singleton at the same offsets; ProcessAddedTraders adds the trader entity to FrameData+0 (EoCServer.dll+0x265780 -> HashSet insert hashing a uint64 key by modulo). bg3.exe destructor bg3.exe+0xD73580 frees 4 HashSets (bg3.exe+0x582AD0) at +0x90,+0x60,+0x30,+0; size 0xC0 at bg3.exe+0x30F4280.

open_questions: Set names come from the Toolkit method that fills each set (offsets confirmed on bg3.exe by the destructor and live samples, membership by the Toolkit only)
key confirmed as a uint64 hashed by modulo; EntityHandle inferred from the trader entity being added
